item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J00340","case1_error":"Omits the $20 flat fee from the total deposit; the correct total is $52.","case2_error":"Assigns the friend's 40% share to John, who owes the remaining 60%, or $1,200.","reason":"The first omits a fixed charge; the second uses another person's percentage share for the requested payer.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00341","case1_error":"Gives unsupported $475 after correct cost formulas; the required total is $752.","case2_error":"Leading answer marker says 8, but the derivation and concluding answer correctly give 20 weeks.","reason":"The second has only an answer-marker conflict, so a shared mathematical error cannot be established.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J00342","case1_error":"Incorrectly evaluates the calorie sum as 2,175 instead of 1,975.","case2_error":"Incorrectly evaluates the seven daily counts' sum as 107 instead of 97.","reason":"Both numerically mis evaluate a correctly written sum, with correct quantities included.","judgment":"same"},{"pair_id":"J00343","case1_error":"Treats current fuel as total required capacity, then subtracts only truck fuel, yielding 4 instead of 18 gallons.","case2_error":"Treats four-cut groups as gallons, omitting the two gallons per group; the correct total is 12 gallons.","reason":"The first constructs an incorrect capacity-minus-current-fuel relation; the second omits a consumption conversion factor.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00344","case1_error":"Subtracts car spending from the console price instead of subtracting remaining savings, yielding 13 rather than 16 hours.","case2_error":"Omits both sign-up fees from first-year costs, yielding $480 instead of $650.","reason":"The first uses the wrong financial balance relation; the second excludes required additive fees.","judgment":"different"}]}
